test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Seven boxes, M, N, O, P, Q, R and S, are kept one over the other, but not necessarily in the same order. Only two boxes are kept between M and O. Only N is kept above S. No box is kept below O. R is kept at some place below P but at some place above Q. Which box is kept third above Q?
solution:
Seven boxes, M, N, O, P, Q, R and S, are kept one over the other, but not necessarily in the same order.**

1. Only two boxes are kept between M and O.

2. Only N is kept above S.

3. No box is kept below O.

4. R is kept at some place below P but at some place above Q.

P box is kept third above Q.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 1**”.
